name: V&I Custom Furniture
old_description: Kitchens, closets, built-ins, and custom storage — designed and handcrafted in the Bay Area.
about:
V&I Custom Furniture operates from a workshop in Menlo Park, California, serving clients throughout the Bay Area. The studio focuses on fully custom cabinetry and furniture for both residential and commercial projects.

The company designs and handcrafts a range of built-in pieces, including kitchens, closets, bathroom vanities, entertainment centers, home offices, wine storage, and shelving. All work is produced in their Menlo Park workshop using traditional joinery and finishing techniques, with each project planned around the client's specific space and requirements. The firm also handles delivery and professional installation across the region.

V&I works directly with homeowners, interior designers, and builders, treating each project as a collaboration that emphasizes clear communication from initial consultation through final installation. The studio offers free consultations for custom cabinetry and furniture projects.

The company distinguishes itself by avoiding prefabricated or flat-pack components, instead using premium materials selected for durability and daily use. Its process centers on custom planning, handcrafted construction, and a reliable workflow that aims for a precise, seamless fit in every installation.
